simple.meaning: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard ; generally, to protect , attend to , etc.
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁמַר (H8104) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 469 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁמַר (shâmar) means properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard ; generally, to protect , attend to , etc. First listed occurrence: 1Chr 9 19.

definitions.short: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard ; generally, to protect , attend to , etc.
definitions.usage: beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).
definitions.full: H8104. shamar I. שָׁמַר 465 verb keep, watch, preserve (Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician שמר in proper name and (Punic) = watchman ; Tel Amarna šimiru is perhaps overseer (Canaanism), Wkl No. 80, i. 23 ; Mandean סמירא preserved Nö M 46 ; compare Arabic converse by night, stay awake (see Lag BN 105 ); Ba NB 175 f.; ES 43 infers from eyelid (compare [ שְׁמֻרָה ] below), and Arabic support, aid, protect (l = r) , that two √ √ are combined in Hebrew; but proof insufficient); — Qal 425 Perfect 3masculine singular ׳שׁ Gen 37:11 +, etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׁמֹר 1Sam 2:9 +, יִשְׁמָרֿ Jer 5:24 +, suffix 3 masculine singular יִשְׁמְרֶנּוּ Exod 21:29 , 36 ; 3 feminine singular suffix תִּשְׁמוּרֵ֑ם Prov 14:3 (read תִּשְׁמְרוּם , see Ges § 47g Toy), etc.; Imperative masculine singular שְׁמֹר Job 2:6 +, שָׁמְרָה 1Chr 29:18 +; masculine plural שִׁמְרוּ Josh 6:18 +, etc.; Infinitive absolute שָׁמוֺר Deut 5:12 +; construct שְׁמֹר Gen 3:24 +, suffix שָׁמְרָהּ 2:15 , etc.; Participle active שֹׁמֵר 1Sam 1:12 +, etc.; passive שָׁמוּר Eccl 5:12 ( 1Sam 9:24 see below), etc.; — [Synon. I. נָטַר נָצַר, , q. v.]: 1. a. keep, have charge of , garden Gen 2:15 (J), ark 1Sam 7:1 , property in trust Exod 22:6 ; 22:9 (E), compare 1Sam 25:31 ; tend flock Gen 30:31 (E), compare Zech 3:7 ; Num 3:8 (P); so perhaps (object omitted) Hosea 12:13 (where ׳שׁ chosen for parallelism Now Marti and others); Participle אָנֹ֑כִי אָחִי הֲשֹׁמֵר Gen 4:9 (J), ׳שׁ of sheep 1Sam 17:20 , ׳שׁ הַכֵּלִים 17:22 , ׳שׁ הַכְּגָדִים 2Kin 22:14 ;
